name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The door must eventually be opened." (Existence(door_open) hard) is redundant because the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) already force door_open to occur. Drop this clause. Additionally, the clause "The key should not be dropped while the door remains closed." (Absence(key_lost) soft) incorrectly forbids the key from ever being lost, whereas the task only requires the key not to be dropped while the door is closed. The clause should be a conditional soft rule that applies only when door_open is false, e.g., a soft Absence(key_lost) guarded by !door_open. Adjust the clause accordingly.

texts: The target box must eventually be picked up.
The target box cannot be picked up before the door is opened.
Prefer that the key is not dropped while the door remains closed.
